# Setup mock source
mkdir mock-source/skill1
-- mock-source/axen.json --
{
  "axen_version": "1",
  "name": "mock-source",
  "skills": {
    "skill1": { "path": "skill1" }
  }
}
-- mock-source/skill1/SKILL.md --
# Skill 1

# Add source and install
exec axen source add ./mock-source
exec axen install mock-source --skills skill1 --targets claude

exists $AXEN_TEST_HOME/.claude/skills/skill1

# Simulate upstream change (skill1 removed, skill2 added)
mkdir mock-source/skill2
rm mock-source/skill1/SKILL.md
-- mock-source/axen.json --
{
  "axen_version": "1",
  "name": "mock-source",
  "skills": {
    "skill2": { "path": "skill2" }
  }
}
-- mock-source/skill2/SKILL.md --
# Skill 2

# Update
exec axen update mock-source

# Verify skill1 was pruned and skill2 was installed (because syncAll is on by default)
! exists $AXEN_TEST_HOME/.claude/skills/skill1
exists $AXEN_TEST_HOME/.claude/skills/skill2
